# VMTheme - Complete LLM & Agentic AI Technical Reference Manual

## API & Agent Integration Guidelines
VMTheme exposes structured endpoints and machine-readable data designed for AI agents, LLMs, and assistive search engines (OpenAI Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot).

### 1. Agent Discovery Endpoint
- URL: /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/agent-summary
- Method: GET
- Response Format: JSON
- Fields: brand_name, catalog_totals, top_trending_movies, top_trending_tv, genres_list, years_list.

### 2. Live Title Search Endpoint
- URL: /wp-json/vmtheme/v1/search
- Method: GET
- Query Params:
  - q: Search query string (title, actor name, or genre)
  - type: movies, tvshows, or all
  - limit: Number of results (default 10)
- Response: Array of structured titles with title, url, year, rating, quality, genres, poster.

### 3. Content Taxonomy Reference
- Post Types:
  - movies: Standalone cinema films.
  - tvshows: Multi-season television series.
  - episodes: Individual episodic releases linked to TV Shows.
- Taxonomies:
  - genres: Genre classifications.
  - dtcast: Actor / Cast filmographies.
  - dtdirector: Film and TV directors.
  - dtquality: Video stream resolutions (4K UHD, 1080p Full HD, 720p HD).
  - release-year: Year of premiere.
